title: auth_methods reports 'unix', naming the absence of authentication
description:
On a bare box the token carries auth_methods: ["unix"] (service.rs:362, populated from claim.source()). A consumer whose policy is 'auth_methods must be non-empty' -- the cheapest plausible reading of that field name -- now passes unconditionally on Unix, where before this change it could not be reached at all.

sources: ["unix"] is honest. auth_methods is not, because getuid() is not an authentication method. Either omit the unix source from auth_methods or rename the field.
